hero.name: Parth Chauhan
hero.intro: Frontend engineer with 5+ years of experience building fast, scalable web products.

bio: I'm a frontend engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications. I work across modern frontend architecture, full-stack feature development, and AI-powered integrations.

I care about the details that make an interface feel fast and dependable — rendering performance, Web Vitals, and accessible design systems — and I use AI-assisted engineering to ship quickly without compromising code quality, usability, or reliability.

highlights: Revamped the HelpApp portal by integrating Gladly CMS and Gladly chat for streamlined customer support, and improved performance by optimizing rendering patterns to enhance Web Vitals and loading speed.
Redesigned the Order Details page with a responsive, user-friendly layout, improving clarity and reducing the customer contact rate from 11% to 8%.
Contributing to the internal design system by upgrading the base component library from Chakra UI v2 to v3.
Improved the Ratings & Reviews portal's performance by minimizing the volume of network requests (N+1 query problem) and improved search through debounce optimization.
Took ownership of deployments and set the standard practice for migrating CI/CD pipelines from Azure DevOps to GitHub Actions.
Owned and maintained 4 web apps, handling upcoming feature requests, writing test cases, and addressing technical debt.
Implemented a modular, responsive chat app from scratch.
Migrated 4 web apps from a monolithic architecture to a micro-frontend setup, enabling individualized deployments.
